desc: A frosted and toasted whole grain oat-based, gluten-free cereal with marshmallow pieces. Each serving of this frosted toasted cereal with marshmallows provides 19g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, a good source of calcium, an excellent source (20% daily value) of vitamin D.
features:
• A frosted and toasted 11 grams whole grain per serving, oat-based, gluten-free cereal with marshmallow pieces.
  • Convenient and easy to display branded box, 12 - 10.5 oz. boxes per case.
  • Multi-serve format box great for smaller operations. Serve all day as a low-cost meal option.
  • Gluten free breakfast cereal.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
